topic: the Cardiff Giant -- an 1869 hoax stone giant built to win a Bible argument, then faked again by P.T. Barnum
title: The 'Petrified Giant' That Was Never Even Real Stone
description: AI-narrated history commentary: the true story of the 1869 Cardiff Giant hoax, a ten-foot carved gypsum 'petrified man' built to win an argument, and how P.T. Barnum later faked the fake.

hook_candidates.text: The 10-foot giant they dug up in 1869 wasn't a fossil, it wasn't even real stone.
You think the Cardiff Giant was an ancient fossil. It was carved a year earlier to win an argument.
What if an entire town paid to see a giant that was carved in a workshop the year before?
In 1869, two well-diggers in New York struck something that made national news for months.

share_trigger: A viewer sends this to the friend who takes every argument about the Bible way too seriously, because they want to prove one guy spent a fortune just to win one.
contradicted_belief: Most people assume a giant they dug up out of the ground in 1869 was real ancient stone, not something carved a year earlier.
closing_comment: George Hull spent thousands building a fake giant just to win one argument about the Bible.

sources.note: Confirms 1869 discovery, George Hull's confession, and the argument-with-a-minister origin.
Confirms gypsum construction, acid/needle aging technique, and P.T. Barnum's competing fake.
